settings.content: This ONLY controls what the storefront says. The money is discounted by the automatic discount in Shopify Admin → Discounts. If the two disagree, the page is advertising a rate the customer will not get.

settings.label: Campaign is running
settings.info: Turn on ONLY while the matching automatic discount is active in Shopify Admin. Off = no badge renders anywhere.

settings.label: Participation tag
settings.info: Must be the SAME tag used by the smart collection the automatic discount is scoped to. That is what keeps the badge and the checkout price covering identical products.

settings.label: Discount on 2nd item
settings.info: Copy of the rate set in Shopify Admin → Discounts. Liquid cannot read an automatic discount, so change BOTH in the same sitting.

settings.content: The discount applies to the CHEAPER of two items, not to the item on screen. Every label must keep its object — «-30% على الثانية», never «-30%» alone, which would read as this piece being 30% off.

settings.label: Badge — what the rate applies to
settings.info: Rendered directly after the percentage. Never leave this blank.

settings.label: Product page — small print
settings.default: كيبان أوتوماتيكيا فالسلة بلا كود · كيتطبق على قطعة وحدة فكل طلب.

settings.content: Used when a product carries a genuine Shopify compare-at price. Independent of the campaign above — the saving and the percentage are always calculated from the two real prices.
